notes.summary: This continuing letter page discusses prime-to-p profinite completions, states that an approach is clear in characteristic 0, and anticipates additional difficulty or mystery in positive characteristic for varieties that resist lifting even birationally. After a separator, the writer says he cannot yet extract a precise algebraic programme from these geometric reflections. He then asks how much cohomological information, including variable coefficients, a multiplicative pairing and possibly further cohomological operations, would suffice to reconstruct an ordinary homotopy type. The page ends during the qualification beginning (disons,. These are transcribed statements and questions, not verified theorems.
